Can you explain more why bmcweb needs a watchdog now? What requests would get hung?
+1.  The commit message needs some amount of "why" and potential situations that this helps.
update the commit message. Please let me know if anything else is required.
Bunch of minor changes, and some documentation, then should be good.
Because bmcweb supports reload, don't we also now need to notify on RELOADING=1 and READY=1 ?

READY=1 not sure if its needed for service type 'simple'. Once the main process is started the service is considered ready. We might not need RELOADING=1 unless our reloading sequence is expected to take more than the watchdog timeout. Not having this can help to recover if if get hung in reloading.

Can you please just test that "systemd reload bmcweb" works properly, then this should be fine.

By my reading of the systemd docs, enabling
this option would make me think that we need to issue reloaded for this to work and not watchdog timeout after a reload.  If it works without it, great.
